reason: The "no effect" conclusion rests on an unjustified central-region-only subsample (N=661 after trimming) with a wide SE (0.38), and a non-significant result there doesn't show there is no effect. When I re-ran it by region, the south showed a significant negative effect (about -0.9, p=0.016) while the north and central did not, so the effect may vary by region. The full-sample estimate (about -0.28, p=0.24) is also imprecise, and the report doesn't say why it chose one region.
